source: Sifra, Vayikra Dibbura DeNedavah, Chapter 8 2 + Section 8
claim_en: The single-caller exception (only the minchah refuses partners) and the standalone-donation menu, open at frankincense/wine/oil and closed at incense by Exod 30:9.
Oil on all, frankincense on part — placement follows sample participation; any man pours and mixes, only a priest takes the fistful.
The fistful: constant not linear (one fist for one or sixty tenths); the three-finger level measure; sample purity (a pebble invalidates); no neighbor's flour.

source: Sifra, Vayikra Dibbura DeNedavah, Section 9 8-11 + Chapter 11 1
claim_en: Quantity floors on the data channel: any shortfall from the tenth or the log invalidates; the fistful/remainder dependency direction; whole not halves.

source: Sifra, Vayikra Dibbura DeNedavah, Chapter 10 2 + Section 10
claim_en: The vow parser: the normalization table (barley to wheat, half to whole) with R. Shimon's void-instead reading; the oven device spec; the no-mixing dispute.
Role-differentiated processing: fold-to-quarters with three execution paths (Israelite separated, priests' not, high priest's unfolded); the vessel taxonomy dispute.
Per-step leaven liability — baking singled out decomposes the composite op; olive-size suffices; leftovers count; leaven/honey mutual non-derivability.

source: Sifra, Vayikra Dibbura DeNedavah, Chapter 14; Onkelos Lev 2:13
claim_en: The salt covenant term: fistful-class only, any salt from anywhere, overrides Sabbath and uncleanness; Onkelos writes covenant-annulment language into the verse.

source: Sifra, Vayikra Dibbura DeNedavah, Section 13 + Chapter 15 1-2; Onkelos Lev 2:14
claim_en: The omer: barley, parch-before-grind by word-order disambiguation, the IF-token as intent grading (with the mandatory and suspension-witness readings), the dry fallback, communal.

source: Sifra, Vayikra Dibbura DeNedavah, Chapter 15 3-5 + Section 12 7-9
claim_en: The adjunct matrix closed member-by-member; the two loaves' scheduling (first of the year, before bikkurim, Shavuot-only).
